en: The postcard features a colored image of a scenic riverside area with two large metal bridges crossing over a wide river. In the foreground, there are several houses with red and white roofs, lots of greenery, and a partial paved road. The bridges are prominent. The text 'Broarna, Bergeforsen' appears on the image, indicating the name of the location. The back of the postcard contains handwritten text in Swedish, printed information about a Stockholm publisher, and recipient information.
